source.text: אֵל־נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיַע׃

records.literal_gloss: God of vengeance, YHWH, God of vengeance, shine forth!

en.L: God of vengeance, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q God of vengeance, shine forth!
en.B: God of retribution, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q God of retribution, shine out!
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the God who pays back evildoers. \q Show {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} in all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} brightness!

fr.L: Dieu des vengeances, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q Dieu des vengeances, resplendis !
fr.B: Dieu qui fais justice, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q Dieu qui fais justice, parais dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lumière !
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le Dieu qui fait payer ceux qui font le mal. \q Montre-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} dans tout {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} éclat !

sw.L: Ee Mungu wa kisasi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q Ee Mungu wa kisasi, angaza!
sw.B: Ee Mungu wa malipizi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q Ee Mungu wa malipizi, uangaze!
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu anayewalipa watenda maovu. \q Ujionyeshe katika mng'ao {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wote!

es.L: Dios de las venganzas, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q Dios de las venganzas, ¡resplandece!
es.B: Dios de la justa retribución, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q Dios de la justa retribución, ¡muestra tu resplandor!
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Dios que da su merecido a los malhechores. \q ¡Muéstrate con todo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} resplandor!

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời của sự báo trả, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q Đức Chúa Trời của sự báo trả, xin chiếu sáng ra!
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của sự báo ứng, \q Đức Chúa Trời của sự báo ứng, xin hiện ra rực rỡ!
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng báo trả kẻ làm ác. \q Xin tỏ mình ra trong tất cả vinh quang rực rỡ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

decisions.choice: vengeance: just punishment by the judge
decisions.reason: The word (neqamah) is not private revenge but the judge's act of setting wrong right (Deuteronomy 32:35, 41; Romans 12:19). God is asked to do what the judges of the land have failed to do (verses 20-21).

decisions.choice: shine forth: appear in glory
decisions.reason: The verb (yafa', causative) is used of God appearing to act (50:2; 80:2; Deuteronomy 33:2).

decisions.choice: a psalm for the fourth day
decisions.reason: Psalm 94 has no title in the Hebrew. The Mishnah (Tamid 7:4) lists it as the psalm sung in the temple on the fourth day of the week, and the ancient Greek translation gives it a title for that day.

decisions.choice: retribution (B); pays back evildoers (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable avoid a word that can suggest personal spite (m1).

decisions.choice: "Dieu qui fais justice" at Balanced for "God of vengeance"
decisions.reason: French "vengeance" today sounds like personal spite. The Hebrew word is the judge's act of setting wrong right, which the English Balanced "retribution" says; Literal keeps "vengeances", plural as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "kisasi" (vengeance) at Literal, "malipizi" (retribution) at Balanced
decisions.reason: "Kisasi" is often heard as personal revenge; Balanced uses "malipizi", repayment for wrong done, as the English moves from "vengeance" to "retribution".

source.text: הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָאָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל־גֵּאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift yourself up, Judge of the earth; return recompense upon [the] proud.

en.L: Lift {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} up, Judge of the earth; \q return recompense upon [the] proud.
en.B: Stand up, Judge of all the earth, \q and give the arrogant what their deeds have earned.
en.R: Judge of the whole world, get up! \q Give proud people the punishment they deserve.

fr.L: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Juge de la terre ; \q rends [leur] salaire aux orgueilleux.
fr.B: Dresse-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Juge de toute la terre, \q et donne aux arrogants ce que leurs actes ont mérité.
fr.R: Juge du monde entier, lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! \q Donne aux orgueilleux la punition qu’ils méritent.

sw.L: Jiinue, Ee Mhukumu wa dunia; \q uwalipe wenye kiburi malipo [yao].
sw.B: Simama, Ee Mhukumu wa dunia yote, \q uwape wenye majivuno yale ambayo matendo yao yamestahili.
sw.R: Ee Mhukumu wa ulimwengu wote, inuka! \q Uwape watu wenye kiburi adhabu wanayostahili.

es.L: Levántate, Juez de la tierra; \q da su paga a los soberbios.
es.B: Ponte en pie, Juez de toda la tierra, \q y da a los arrogantes lo que sus obras merecen.
es.R: Juez del mundo entero, ¡levántate! \q Dale a la gente orgullosa el castigo que merece.

vi.L: Xin trỗi dậy, hỡi Đấng Phán Xét thế gian; \q xin báo trả xứng đáng trên [những kẻ] kiêu ngạo.
vi.B: Lạy Đấng Phán Xét cả thế gian, xin đứng lên, \q và báo trả cho kẻ kiêu căng điều việc làm chúng đáng nhận.
vi.R: Lạy Đấng Phán Xét cả thế giới, xin hãy đứng dậy! \q Xin trừng phạt những kẻ kiêu ngạo như chúng đáng phải chịu.

decisions.choice: Judge of the earth: Genesis 18:25
decisions.reason: Abraham called God "the Judge of all the earth" who will do what is right (Genesis 18:25).

decisions.choice: recompense: what one's deeds deserve
decisions.reason: The word (gemul) is a deed and what it earns in return (28:4).

source.text: עַד־מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים׀יְהוָ֑ה עַד־מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Until when [will the] wicked, YHWH, until when will [the] wicked exult?

en.L: How long [will the] wicked, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q how long will [the] wicked exult?
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how much longer will the wicked, \q how much longer will the wicked celebrate?
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how long will wicked people keep on celebrating? \q How long?

fr.L: Jusqu’à quand [les] méchants, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q jusqu’à quand [les] méchants exulteront-ils ?
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, combien de temps encore les méchants, \q combien de temps encore les méchants feront-ils la fête ?
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, combien de temps les méchants vont-ils continuer à faire la fête ? \q Combien de temps ?

sw.L: Mpaka lini waovu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mpaka lini waovu watashangilia?
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mpaka lini waovu, \q mpaka lini waovu wataendelea kusherehekea?
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, waovu wataendelea kusherehekea mpaka lini? \q Mpaka lini?

es.L: ¿Hasta cuándo [los] malvados, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q hasta cuándo se regocijarán [los] malvados?
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿hasta cuándo los malvados, \q hasta cuándo seguirán festejando los malvados?
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿hasta cuándo seguirán celebrando los malvados? \q ¿Hasta cuándo?

vi.L: Cho đến bao giờ [những] kẻ ác, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q cho đến bao giờ [những] kẻ ác còn hớn hở?
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, kẻ ác còn đến bao lâu nữa, \q kẻ ác còn ăn mừng đến bao lâu nữa?
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, kẻ ác còn tiếp tục ăn mừng đến bao giờ? \q Đến bao giờ?

decisions.choice: the repeated question
decisions.reason: The question breaks off and starts again, a pattern of Hebrew poetry (92:10; 93:3). "How long" is the cry of 13:2-3.

decisions.choice: exult: celebrate in triumph
decisions.reason: The verb ('alaz) is to rejoice loudly, here in their success.

source.text: יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִֽ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: They pour forth, they speak arrogance; they boast, all [the] doers of wickedness.

en.L: They pour forth, they speak arrogant [words]; \q all who do wickedness boast.
en.B: Insolent words gush from them; \q everyone who does evil talks big.
en.R: They keep bragging and saying proud things. \q All these evil people boast about themselves.

fr.L: Ils déversent, ils disent des [paroles] arrogantes ; \q tous ceux qui font le mal se vantent.
fr.B: De leur bouche jaillissent des paroles insolentes ; \q tous ceux qui font le mal fanfaronnent.
fr.R: Ils n’arrêtent pas de se vanter et de dire des paroles orgueilleuses. \q Tous ces gens mauvais se vantent.

sw.L: Wanabubujika, wanasema [maneno ya] kiburi; \q watenda maovu wote wanajigamba.
sw.B: Maneno ya jeuri yanawatoka kwa wingi; \q kila mtenda maovu anajisifu.
sw.R: Wanaendelea kujisifu na kusema maneno ya kiburi. \q Watu hawa wote waovu wanajigamba.

es.L: Derraman, hablan [palabras] insolentes; \q se jactan todos los que hacen maldad.
es.B: De su boca brotan palabras insolentes; \q todos los que hacen el mal hablan con arrogancia.
es.R: No dejan de presumir y de decir cosas orgullosas. \q Toda esta gente malvada se jacta de sí misma.

vi.L: Chúng tuôn ra, chúng nói [những lời] ngạo mạn; \q mọi kẻ làm điều gian ác đều khoe khoang.
vi.B: Những lời xấc xược tuôn ra từ miệng chúng; \q mọi kẻ làm ác đều huênh hoang.
vi.R: Chúng cứ khoác lác và nói những lời kiêu căng. \q Tất cả những kẻ ác ấy đều tự khoe mình.

decisions.choice: arrogance: insolent, proud speech
decisions.reason: The word ('ataq) is speech that is bold and contemptuous (31:19; 75:6).

decisions.choice: pour forth: gush like a spring
decisions.reason: The verb (nava') is used of a spring bubbling up (Proverbs 18:4): their boasting never stops.

source.text: עַמְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽנַחֲלָתְךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your people, YHWH, they crush, and your inheritance they afflict.

en.L: Your people, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, they crush, \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance they afflict.
en.B: They grind down {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; \q they oppress the nation that belongs to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, they crush {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people. \q They hurt the people who belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Ton peuple, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ils l’écrasent, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage, ils l’oppriment.
fr.B: Ils broient {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q ils oppriment la nation qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartient.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ils écrasent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple. \q Ils font du mal aux gens qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiennent.

sw.L: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wanawaponda, \q na urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanautesa.
sw.B: Wanawasaga watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q wanalionea taifa lililo mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wanawaponda watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \q Wanawaumiza watu walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: A {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, aplastan, \q y a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} heredad afligen.
es.B: Destrozan a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q oprimen a la nación que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenece.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, aplastan a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo. \q Lastiman a la gente que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenece.

vi.L: Dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chúng chà đạp, \q và cơ nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng làm khổ.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chúng đè bẹp dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q chúng áp bức dân tộc thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chúng chà đạp dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chúng làm hại những người thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: your inheritance: the people who are God's own
decisions.reason: Israel is the LORD's inheritance, his own possession (28:9; 33:12; Deuteronomy 32:9).

decisions.choice: the nation (people) that belongs to you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the inheritance is (m1).

source.text: אַ֭לְמָנָה וְגֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִֽיתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Widow and sojourner they kill, and fatherless [ones] they murder.

en.L: [The] widow and [the] sojourner they kill, \q and [the] fatherless they murder.
en.B: Widows and foreigners they put to death; \q orphans they murder.
en.R: They kill widows and foreigners who live among us. \q They murder children who have no father to protect them.

fr.L: La veuve et l’immigré, ils [les] tuent, \q et les orphelins, ils [les] assassinent.
fr.B: Ils mettent à mort les veuves et les étrangers ; \q ils assassinent les orphelins.
fr.R: Ils tuent les veuves et les étrangers qui vivent parmi nous. \q Ils assassinent les enfants qui n’ont pas de père pour les protéger.

sw.L: Mjane na mgeni wanawaua, \q na yatima wanawachinja.
sw.B: Wajane na wageni wanawaua; \q yatima wanawachinja.
sw.R: Wanawaua wajane na wageni wanaoishi kati yetu. \q Wanawaua watoto wasio na baba wa kuwalinda.

es.L: [A la] viuda y [al] extranjero matan, \q y [a los] huérfanos asesinan.
es.B: A las viudas y a los extranjeros les dan muerte; \q a los huérfanos los asesinan.
es.R: Matan a las viudas y a los extranjeros que viven entre nosotros. \q Asesinan a los niños que no tienen padre que los proteja.

vi.L: Người góa bụa và khách lạ chúng giết, \q và [những trẻ] mồ côi chúng sát hại.
vi.B: Chúng giết người góa bụa và khách ngoại kiều; \q chúng sát hại trẻ mồ côi.
vi.R: Chúng giết những người góa bụa và những người nước ngoài sống giữa chúng tôi. \q Chúng giết những đứa trẻ không có cha để che chở.

decisions.choice: widow, foreigner, orphan: the defenseless
decisions.reason: These three had no family or land to protect them, and the law puts them under God's care (Deuteronomy 10:18; 24:17; 27:19). To attack them is to defy God himself.

decisions.choice: sojourner: a foreigner living in the land
decisions.reason: The word (ger) is someone from elsewhere settled among Israel without the rights of a native.

decisions.choice: who live among us; to protect them
decisions.reason: Readable says who the foreigners and the fatherless are (m1, m2).

source.text: וַ֭יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־יָּ֑הּ וְלֹא־יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said, Not will see Yah, and not will perceive [the] God of Jacob.

en.L: And they say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} will not see, \q and the God of Jacob will not perceive."
en.B: They say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} is not looking; \q Jacob's God pays no attention."
en.R: They say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} cannot see what we are doing. \q Israel's God does not even notice."

fr.L: Et ils disent : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ne voit pas, \q et le Dieu de Jacob ne s’en aperçoit pas. »
fr.B: Ils disent : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ne regarde pas ; \q le Dieu de Jacob n’y fait pas attention. »
fr.R: Ils disent : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ne peut pas voir ce que nous faisons. \q Le Dieu d’Israël ne le remarque même pas. »

sw.L: Nao husema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} haoni, \q wala Mungu wa Yakobo hatambui."
sw.B: Wanasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} hatazami; \q Mungu wa Yakobo hajali."
sw.R: Wanasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} hawezi kuona tunachofanya. \q Mungu wa Israeli hata hatambui."

es.L: Y dicen: «No ve {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}}, \q y no se da cuenta el Dios de Jacob».
es.B: Dicen: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} no está mirando; \q el Dios de Jacob no presta atención».
es.R: Dicen: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} no puede ver lo que hacemos. \q El Dios de Israel ni siquiera se da cuenta».

vi.L: Và chúng nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} sẽ không thấy, \q và Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp sẽ không nhận biết."
vi.B: Chúng nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} chẳng nhìn đâu; \q Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp chẳng để ý gì."
vi.R: Chúng nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}} không thể thấy điều chúng ta đang làm. \q Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên còn chẳng để ý nữa."

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a short form of the name YHWH, used mostly in poetry and in praise (Exodus 15:2; 68:5), and in the cry "Hallelu-yah". It names the same God; the divine name setting shows it as "the LORD" or "Yah".

decisions.choice: they said: what they keep saying
decisions.reason: The past form introduces what the wicked say and go on saying (10:11), so it is rendered in the present.

decisions.choice: the God of Jacob: Israel's own God
decisions.reason: Jacob is Israel (Genesis 32), so the wicked deny that the God of their own people sees what they do.

decisions.choice: Israel's God
decisions.reason: Readable uses the better-known name of the people (m3).

source.text: בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּעָ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Understand, stupid [ones] among the people, and fools, when will you be wise?

en.L: Understand, [you] senseless among the people! \q And fools, when will you be wise?
en.B: Get some understanding, you brutish people! \q Fools, when will you start to think wisely?
en.R: You foolish people, think about this! \q When will you ever learn?

fr.L: Comprenez, stupides du peuple ! \q Et insensés, quand serez-vous sages ?
fr.B: Ouvrez votre intelligence, gens bornés ! \q Insensés, quand commencerez-vous à réfléchir avec sagesse ?
fr.R: Vous, les gens stupides, réfléchissez à ceci ! \q Quand allez-vous enfin apprendre ?

sw.L: Fahamuni, [ninyi] wajinga kati ya watu! \q Nanyi wapumbavu, mtakuwa na hekima lini?
sw.B: Pateni ufahamu, enyi watu kama wanyama! \q Enyi wapumbavu, mtaanza lini kufikiri kwa hekima?
sw.R: Enyi watu wapumbavu, fikirini jambo hili! \q Mtajifunza lini?

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Entiendan|Entended}}, insensatos del pueblo! \q Y necios, ¿cuándo {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} sabios?
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Adquieran|Adquirid}} entendimiento, gente torpe! \q Necios, ¿cuándo {{plural_you:empezarán|empezaréis}} a pensar con sabiduría?
es.R: ¡Gente tonta, {{plural_you:piensen|pensad}} en esto! \q ¿Cuándo {{plural_you:van a aprender|vais a aprender}}?

vi.L: Hãy hiểu biết, [hỡi các người] ngu muội trong dân! \q Và hỡi những kẻ dại dột, khi nào các người mới khôn ngoan?
vi.B: Hỡi những kẻ ngu muội như thú vật, hãy hiểu biết! \q Hỡi những kẻ dại dột, bao giờ các người mới chịu suy nghĩ khôn ngoan?
vi.R: Hỡi những kẻ dại dột, hãy suy nghĩ điều này! \q Đến bao giờ các người mới học được?

decisions.choice: stupid: dull as an animal
decisions.reason: The word (ba'ar) is the one of 92:7 and 73:22.

decisions.choice: among the people: within Israel
decisions.reason: The psalm now speaks to people within God's own people, the wicked of verses 4-7 or any who think as they do.

decisions.choice: plural you setting for the people addressed
decisions.reason: The psalm now speaks to a group within the people, so the verbs are plural and take the plural you setting: the Latin American forms by default, with the forms of Spain as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "các người" for "you" when the singer rebukes the fools
decisions.reason: The singer turns on senseless people within Israel (see the meaning decision). "các người" is the plain word for a group one speaks to sharply, as the style guide gives it for opponents; "các ngươi" is archaic and "anh em" too warm for a rebuke.

source.text: הֲנֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶןהֲלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם־יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲלֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט׃

records.literal_gloss: The planter of [the] ear, does he not hear? Or [the] one who formed [the] eye, does he not see?

en.L: The one who planted the ear, does {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not hear? \q Or the one who formed the eye, does {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not see?
en.B: Will the one who set the ear in place not hear? \q Will the one who shaped the eye not see?
en.R: God made our ears. Of course {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} can hear! \q He made our eyes. Of course {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} can see!

fr.L: Celui qui a planté l’oreille n’entendrait-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas ? \q Ou celui qui a formé l’œil ne verrait-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas ?
fr.B: Celui qui a mis l’oreille en place n’entendrait pas ? \q Celui qui a façonné l’œil ne verrait pas ?
fr.R: Dieu a fait nos oreilles. Bien sûr qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} entend ! \q Il a fait nos yeux. Bien sûr qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voit !

sw.L: Aliyepanda sikio, je, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hasikii? \q Au aliyeumba jicho, je, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} haoni?
sw.B: Je, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyeliweka sikio mahali pake hasikii? \q Je, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyelifinyanga jicho haoni?
sw.R: Mungu aliumba masikio yetu. Bila shaka anaweza kusikia! \q Aliumba macho yetu. Bila shaka anaweza kuona!

es.L: El que plantó el oído, ¿no oirá? \q ¿O el que formó el ojo, no verá?
es.B: ¿El que puso el oído en su lugar no va a oír? \q ¿El que dio forma al ojo no va a ver?
es.R: Dios hizo nuestros oídos. ¡Claro que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puede oír! \q Él hizo nuestros ojos. ¡Claro que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puede ver!

vi.L: Đấng đã tạo nên tai, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không nghe sao? \q Hay Đấng đã nắn nên mắt, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không thấy sao?
vi.B: Đấng đã đặt tai vào chỗ, lẽ nào không nghe? \q Đấng đã nắn nên con mắt, lẽ nào không thấy?
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã tạo nên tai chúng ta. Dĩ nhiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe được! \q Ngài đã tạo nên mắt chúng ta. Dĩ nhiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy được!

decisions.choice: planted, formed: made the body
decisions.reason: The ear is pictured as planted in the head; "formed" (yatsar) is the potter's verb used for the making of the first man (Genesis 2:7).

decisions.choice: questions that expect yes
decisions.reason: The answer to "Yah does not see" (verse 7): the maker of eyes sees.

decisions.choice: God; Of course
decisions.reason: Readable turns the questions into statements and names God.

source.text: הֲיֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲלֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת׃

records.literal_gloss: The one who disciplines nations, does he not rebuke? — the one who teaches humankind knowledge.

en.L: The one who disciplines nations, does {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not rebuke — \q the one who teaches {{gender:humankind|man}} knowledge?
en.B: Will the one who disciplines nations not correct them, \q the one who teaches humans all they know?
en.R: God corrects the nations. Of course {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will punish wicked people! \q He teaches people everything they know.

fr.L: Celui qui corrige les nations ne reprendrait-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas, \q {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui enseigne la connaissance à {{gender:l’humain|l’homme}} ?
fr.B: Celui qui corrige les nations ne les reprendrait pas, \q {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui enseigne aux humains tout ce qu’ils savent ?
fr.R: Dieu corrige les nations. Bien sûr qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} punira les méchants ! \q Il apprend aux gens tout ce qu’ils savent.

sw.L: Yeye anayeadibisha mataifa, je, hakemei, \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anayemfundisha mwanadamu maarifa?
sw.B: Je, yule anayeadibisha mataifa hatawarudi, \q yule anayewafundisha wanadamu kila wanachojua?
sw.R: Mungu huyarudi mataifa. Bila shaka atawaadhibu waovu! \q Yeye huwafundisha watu kila kitu wanachojua.

es.L: El que disciplina a las naciones, ¿no reprenderá, \q el que enseña conocimiento {{gender:al ser humano|al hombre}}?
es.B: ¿El que disciplina a las naciones no las va a corregir, \q el que enseña a los seres humanos todo lo que saben?
es.R: Dios corrige a las naciones. ¡Claro que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} castigará a los malvados! \q Él enseña a la gente todo lo que sabe.

vi.L: Đấng sửa phạt các dân tộc, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không quở trách sao, \q Đấng dạy loài người tri thức?
vi.B: Đấng sửa phạt các dân tộc, lẽ nào không sửa trị họ, \q là Đấng dạy cho loài người mọi điều họ biết?
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời sửa phạt các dân tộc. Dĩ nhiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ trừng phạt kẻ ác! \q Ngài dạy cho con người mọi điều họ biết.

decisions.choice: the one who teaches: a line left open
alternatives: does the one who teaches knowledge not know?
decisions.reason: The last line has no verb of its own. It may describe the same God ("the one who teaches humankind knowledge") or imply a third question, "does he not know?", which verse 11 answers.

decisions.choice: disciplines, rebukes: corrects and punishes
decisions.reason: The verbs (yasar, yakach) are used of correction by a father or a judge (6:2; Proverbs 3:11-12).

decisions.choice: humankind (with "man" as the alternative at Literal); humans, people
decisions.reason: The word ('adam) means human beings, so Literal gives inclusive wording by default.

decisions.choice: punish wicked people
decisions.reason: Readable says whom God will correct.

decisions.choice: the gender setting on the noun at Literal: "l'humain" / "l'homme"; Balanced and Readable say "les humains", "les gens" with no setting
decisions.reason: As the English: ʾadam is humanity, men and women.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי־הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH knows [the] thoughts of humankind, that they [are] a breath.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} knows the thoughts of {{gender:humankind|man}}, \q that they [are] a breath.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} knows what humans are thinking, \q and that their thoughts are only a puff of air.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} knows what people are thinking. \q He knows their thoughts are worthless, like a breath of air.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} connaît les pensées de {{gender:l’humain|l’homme}} : \q elles [ne sont qu’]un souffle.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sait ce que pensent les humains, \q et que leurs pensées ne sont qu’un peu d’air.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sait ce que pensent les gens. \q Il sait que leurs pensées ne valent rien, comme un souffle d’air.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayajua mawazo ya mwanadamu, \q kwamba [ni] pumzi.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anajua wanadamu wanachofikiri, \q na kwamba mawazo yao ni mvuke tu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anajua watu wanachofikiri. \q Anajua mawazo yao hayana thamani, ni kama pumzi tu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} conoce los pensamientos {{gender:del ser humano|del hombre}}, \q que [son] un soplo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sabe lo que piensan los seres humanos, \q y que sus pensamientos son solo un soplo.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sabe lo que piensa la gente. \q Sabe que sus pensamientos no valen nada, como un soplo de aire.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} biết những ý tưởng của loài người, \q rằng chúng [chỉ là] một hơi thở.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} biết loài người đang nghĩ gì, \q và biết rằng ý tưởng của họ chỉ là một hơi gió thoảng.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} biết người ta đang nghĩ gì. \q Ngài biết ý nghĩ của họ chẳng có giá trị gì, như một hơi thở.

decisions.choice: a breath: empty, passing
decisions.reason: The word (hevel) is breath or vapor, something without substance (39:6; Ecclesiastes 1:2).

decisions.choice: they: the thoughts, or the people
decisions.reason: "They" may be the thoughts or the humans who think them; either way nothing of it lasts.

decisions.choice: quoted in 1 Corinthians 3:20
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the verse from the Greek translation as "the Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are futile".

decisions.choice: humankind (with "man" as the alternative at Literal); humans, people
decisions.reason: As in verse 10, the word ('adam) means human beings.

decisions.choice: "loài người" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "loài người" already means all people, men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the English gender setting to switch to.

source.text: אַשְׁרֵ֤י׀הַגֶּ֣בֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶ֣נּוּ יָּ֑הּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: How blessed [is] the man whom you discipline, Yah, and from your instruction you teach him,

en.L: How blessed [is] {{gender:the one|the man}} whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} discipline, {{divine_name:LORD|Yah}}, \q and whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} teach from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction,
en.B: How blessed is {{gender:the one|the man}} whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} correct, {{divine_name:LORD|Yah}}, \q and train through {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction,
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yah}}, life is truly good for the people {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} correct \q and guide by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: {{gender:Heureuse la personne|Heureux l’homme}} que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} corriges, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, \q et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instruis par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi,
fr.B: Heureux celui que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} reprends, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, \q et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} formes par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction,
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, ceux que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} corriges \q et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} guides par {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement sont vraiment heureux.

sw.L: Heri mtu yule unayemwadibisha, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, \q na unayemfundisha kutoka katika sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}},
sw.B: Heri mtu yule unayemrudi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, \q ukamfunza kwa maelekezo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}},
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, maisha ni mazuri kweli kwa watu unaowarudi \q na kuwaongoza kwa mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: ¡{{gender:Dichosa la persona|Dichoso el hombre}} a quien {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} disciplinas, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yah}}, \q y a quien enseñas con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción,
es.B: ¡Qué {{gender:dichosa es la persona|dichoso es el hombre}} a quien {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} corriges, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yah}}, \q y formas por medio de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción,
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yah}}, qué buena es la vida de los que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} corriges \q y guías con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza.

vi.L: Phước thay người được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sửa phạt, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}, \q và được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy dỗ từ sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Phước hạnh thay người được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sửa dạy, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}, \q và được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rèn luyện qua lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}, thật hạnh phúc cho những người được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sửa dạy \q và hướng dẫn bằng lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: How blessed: a life that goes well
decisions.reason: The exclamation ('ashre) of 1:1. The one God trains is better off than the wicked who seem to prosper.

decisions.choice: discipline: train and correct like a father
decisions.reason: The verb (yasar) of verse 10: as a father trains his son (Deuteronomy 8:5; Proverbs 3:11-12), God corrects his people, not to destroy them.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a short form of the name YHWH, used mostly in poetry and in praise (Exodus 15:2; 68:5), and in the cry "Hallelu-yah". It names the same God; the divine name setting shows it as "the LORD" or "Yah".

decisions.choice: instruction: torah
decisions.reason: The word (torah) is God's teaching and direction for life (1:2).

decisions.choice: the one (with "the man" as the alternative); the people (R)
decisions.reason: The word (gever) is a man, but the blessing is for anyone God trains (1:1), so the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default; Readable uses the plural.

decisions.choice: life is truly good for
decisions.reason: As in 1:1.

decisions.choice: no gender setting at Balanced: "Heureux celui que"
alternatives: a span, as the English Balanced has
decisions.reason: French "celui que" already means anyone, so the Balanced needs no setting, as the French style guide sets for generic pronouns. Literal keeps the noun and the setting on it.

source.text: לְהַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֭וֹמִ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָרָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת׃

records.literal_gloss: to give rest to him from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.

en.L: to give {{gender:them|him}} rest from days of trouble, \q until a pit is dug for the wicked.
en.B: giving {{gender:them|him}} calm in the days of trouble, \q while the pit is being dug for the wicked.
en.R: You give them peace when times are hard, \q until a grave is dug for wicked people.

fr.L: pour lui donner du repos loin des jours de malheur, \q jusqu’à ce que la fosse soit creusée pour le méchant.
fr.B: lui donnant le calme aux jours de malheur, \q pendant que la fosse se creuse pour le méchant.
fr.R: Tu leur donnes la paix quand les temps sont durs, \q jusqu’à ce qu’on creuse une tombe pour les méchants.

sw.L: ili umpe raha mbali na siku za taabu, \q mpaka shimo litakapochimbwa kwa ajili ya mwovu.
sw.B: ukimpa utulivu katika siku za taabu, \q huku shimo likichimbwa kwa ajili ya waovu.
sw.R: Unawapa amani nyakati zinapokuwa ngumu, \q mpaka kaburi litakapochimbwa kwa ajili ya waovu.

es.L: para darle descanso de los días de angustia, \q hasta que se cave una fosa para el malvado.
es.B: dándole calma en los días de angustia, \q mientras se cava la fosa para el malvado.
es.R: Les das paz cuando los tiempos son difíciles, \q hasta que se cave una tumba para los malvados.

vi.L: để ban cho người ấy sự nghỉ ngơi khỏi những ngày gian nan, \q cho đến khi một hố sâu được đào cho kẻ ác.
vi.B: ban cho người ấy sự bình yên trong những ngày khốn khó, \q trong khi hố sâu đang được đào cho kẻ ác.
vi.R: Ngài ban cho họ sự bình an khi gặp lúc khó khăn, \q cho đến khi một nấm mồ được đào cho kẻ ác.

decisions.choice: give rest: give quiet, calm
decisions.reason: The verb (shaqat) is to be quiet and undisturbed. God's teaching gives inner calm through the bad days, while the end of the wicked is being prepared.

decisions.choice: a pit is dug: their downfall is being prepared
decisions.reason: A pit is a trap or a grave (7:16; 9:16). The wicked who dug pits for others fall into one.

decisions.choice: a grave
decisions.reason: Readable gives one likely sense of the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: darle, dándole, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal and Balanced say "them" with "him" as the alternative. Spanish "le" already takes in a woman or a man, so it needs no setting.

source.text: כִּ֤י׀לֹא־יִטֹּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְ֝נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א יַעֲזֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: For YHWH will not abandon his people, and his inheritance he will not forsake.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not abandon {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not forsake.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will not reject {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will never desert those who belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will never leave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people alone. \q He will not give up on the people who belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne délaissera pas {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, \q et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne l’abandonnera pas.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne rejettera pas {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; \q jamais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’abandonnera ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne laissera jamais {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple tout seul. \q Il ne laissera pas tomber ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawaacha watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q wala urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hatauacha.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawakataa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q hatawatupa kamwe wale walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawaacha kamwe watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} peke yao. \q Hatawakatia tamaa watu walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no abandonará a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, \q y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} heredad no desamparará.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no rechazará a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; \q nunca dejará a los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecen.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nunca dejará solo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. \q No abandonará a la gente que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenece.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không bỏ dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không lìa bỏ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không ruồng bỏ dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chẳng bao giờ lìa bỏ những người thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không bao giờ bỏ mặc dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài sẽ không từ bỏ những người thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: the LORD will not abandon his people: 1 Samuel 12:22
decisions.reason: Samuel promised the same with the same verb: "the LORD will not abandon his people, for the sake of his great name".

decisions.choice: his inheritance: his own people
decisions.reason: As in verse 5.

source.text: כִּֽי־עַד־צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝אַחֲרָ֗יו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: For to righteousness judgment will return, and after it [will be] all [the] upright of heart.

en.L: For judgment will return to righteousness, \q and after it [will go] all the upright of heart.
en.B: For justice will once again be joined to what is right, \q and all who are honest at heart will follow it.
en.R: Once more, judging will be fair and right, \q and all honest people will follow that way.

fr.L: Car le jugement reviendra à la justice, \q et après lui [iront] tous ceux qui ont le cœur droit.
fr.B: Car la justice des jugements rejoindra de nouveau ce qui est droit, \q et tous ceux qui ont le cœur honnête la suivront.
fr.R: De nouveau, on jugera de façon juste et droite, \q et tous les gens honnêtes suivront ce chemin.

sw.L: Kwa maana hukumu itairudia haki, \q na nyuma yake [watafuata] wote walio wanyofu wa moyo.
sw.B: Kwa maana hukumu itaungana tena na yaliyo ya haki, \q na wote walio wanyofu wa moyo wataifuata.
sw.R: Kwa mara nyingine, hukumu itakuwa ya haki na ya kweli, \q na watu wote wanyofu wataifuata njia hiyo.

es.L: Porque el juicio volverá a la justicia, \q y tras él [irán] todos los rectos de corazón.
es.B: Porque la justicia volverá a unirse con lo que es recto, \q y todos los de corazón sincero la seguirán.
es.R: Otra vez se juzgará con justicia y rectitud, \q y toda la gente honesta seguirá ese camino.

vi.L: Vì sự xét xử sẽ trở về với sự công chính, \q và theo sau nó [sẽ là] mọi người có lòng ngay thẳng.
vi.B: Vì công lý sẽ lại gắn liền với lẽ phải, \q và mọi người có lòng ngay thẳng sẽ đi theo.
vi.R: Việc xét xử sẽ lại công bằng và đúng đắn, \q và mọi người ngay thẳng sẽ đi theo con đường đó.

decisions.choice: judgment: the giving of verdicts, justice
decisions.reason: The word (mishpat) is what judges do. Now it is twisted (verses 20-21); it will again be done rightly.

decisions.choice: judgment will return to righteousness: justice will be righteous again
alternatives: justice will return to the righteous
decisions.reason: The line says that judging will come back to what is right. Some read it as justice returning to the righteous person.

decisions.choice: upright of heart: people honest within
decisions.reason: As in 7:11 and 32:11.

source.text: מִֽי־יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם־מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝י עִם־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: Who will rise up for me against evildoers? Who will take his stand for me against doers of wickedness?

en.L: Who will rise up for me against evildoers? \q Who will take a stand for me against those who do wickedness?
en.B: Who will take my side against the wicked? \q Who will stand with me against those who do wrong?
en.R: Who will help me fight against evil people? \q Who will defend me against those who do wrong?

fr.L: Qui se lèvera pour moi contre les malfaiteurs ? \q Qui se tiendra pour moi contre ceux qui font le mal ?
fr.B: Qui prendra mon parti contre les méchants ? \q Qui se tiendra avec moi contre ceux qui font le mal ?
fr.R: Qui va m’aider à combattre les gens mauvais ? \q Qui va me défendre contre ceux qui font le mal ?

sw.L: Ni nani atakayeniinukia dhidi ya watenda mabaya? \q Ni nani atakayesimama kwa ajili yangu dhidi ya watenda maovu?
sw.B: Ni nani atakayekuwa upande wangu dhidi ya waovu? \q Ni nani atakayesimama pamoja nami dhidi ya watenda mabaya?
sw.R: Ni nani atakayenisaidia kupigana na watu waovu? \q Ni nani atakayenitetea dhidi ya watenda mabaya?

es.L: ¿Quién se levantará por mí contra los malhechores? \q ¿Quién se pondrá en pie por mí contra los que hacen maldad?
es.B: ¿Quién se pondrá de mi parte contra los malvados? \q ¿Quién estará conmigo contra los que hacen el mal?
es.R: ¿Quién me ayudará a luchar contra la gente malvada? \q ¿Quién me defenderá de los que hacen el mal?

vi.L: Ai sẽ đứng lên vì tôi chống lại những kẻ làm ác? \q Ai sẽ đứng ra vì tôi chống lại những kẻ làm điều gian ác?
vi.B: Ai sẽ đứng về phía tôi chống lại kẻ ác? \q Ai sẽ đứng cùng tôi chống lại những kẻ làm điều sai trái?
vi.R: Ai sẽ giúp tôi chiến đấu chống lại kẻ ác? \q Ai sẽ bênh vực tôi trước những kẻ làm điều sai trái?

decisions.choice: who will rise up?: no human helper
decisions.reason: The questions find no one among people; verse 17 gives the answer: the LORD.

decisions.choice: rise up, take a stand: as a witness or defender in court
decisions.reason: The verbs are used of standing up in court for someone (Deuteronomy 19:16; Job 33:5).

source.text: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י כִּמְעַ֓ט׀שָֽׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: If YHWH [had] not [been] a help to me, soon my soul would have dwelt [in] silence.

en.L: If {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [had] not [been] a help to me, \q my soul would soon have dwelt [in] silence.
en.B: If {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not helped me, \q I would soon have been living where all is silent.
en.R: If {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not helped me, \q I would soon have died and gone to the silent place of the dead.

fr.L: Si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’[avait] pas [été] un secours pour moi, \q bientôt mon âme aurait habité [dans le] silence.
fr.B: Si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne m’avait pas secouru, \q je serais bientôt allé vivre là où tout se tait.
fr.R: Si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne m’avait pas aidé, \q je serais bientôt mort et parti au monde silencieux des morts.

sw.L: Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [asingekuwa] msaada wangu, \q nafsi yangu ingekuwa imekaa upesi [katika] ukimya.
sw.B: Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asingenisaidia, \q ningekuwa nimekwisha kwenda kuishi mahali pa ukimya.
sw.R: Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asingenisaidia, \q ningekuwa nimekwisha kufa na kwenda mahali pa wafu palipo kimya.

es.L: Si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no [hubiera sido] mi ayuda, \q pronto habría habitado mi alma [en el] silencio.
es.B: Si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no me hubiera ayudado, \q pronto estaría yo viviendo donde todo es silencio.
es.R: Si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no me hubiera ayudado, \q pronto me habría muerto y habría ido al silencioso lugar de los muertos.

vi.L: Nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [đã] không [là] sự giúp đỡ cho tôi, \q thì linh hồn tôi chắc đã sớm ở [nơi] im lặng.
vi.B: Nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã không giúp đỡ tôi, \q thì tôi đã sớm phải ở nơi mọi sự đều im lặng.
vi.R: Nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã không giúp đỡ tôi, \q thì tôi đã sớm chết và đi xuống nơi im lặng của người chết.

decisions.choice: silence: the realm of the dead
decisions.reason: The word (dumah) is the silence of the grave, where no one praises God (115:17).

decisions.choice: my soul: I, my life
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) is the whole living person (6:4).

decisions.choice: I
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "I" for "my soul" (m2).

decisions.choice: the silent place of the dead
decisions.reason: Readable says what the silence is (m1).

source.text: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי מָ֣טָה רַגְלִ֑י חַסְדְּךָ֥ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִסְעָדֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: When I said, My foot slips, your loyal love, YHWH, supported me.

en.L: When I said, "My foot has slipped," \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, held me up.
en.B: The moment I said, "My foot is giving way," \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, held me up.
en.R: When I cried, "I am falling!" \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love held me up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Quand j’ai dit : « Mon pied a glissé », \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, m’a soutenu.
fr.B: Au moment où j’ai dit : « Mon pied lâche », \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, m’a soutenu.
fr.R: Quand j’ai crié : « Je tombe ! », \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle m’a tenu debout, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Niliposema, "Mguu wangu umeteleza," \q upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ulinitegemeza.
sw.B: Mara niliposema, "Mguu wangu unateleza," \q upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ulinishikilia.
sw.R: Nilipolia, "Ninaanguka!" \q upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ulinishikilia, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Cuando dije: «Mi pie ha resbalado», \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, me sostuvo.
es.B: En cuanto dije: «Mi pie está cediendo», \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, me sostuvo.
es.R: Cuando grité: «¡Me estoy cayendo!», \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel me sostuvo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Khi tôi nói: "Chân tôi đã trượt", \q thì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã nâng đỡ tôi.
vi.B: Ngay khi tôi nói: "Chân tôi đang trượt ngã", \q thì lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nâng đỡ tôi.
vi.R: Khi tôi kêu lên: "Tôi đang ngã!" \q Thì lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đỡ tôi lên.

decisions.choice: my foot slips: I am about to fall into disaster
decisions.reason: A slipping foot is a picture of coming to ruin (38:17; 73:2).

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

source.text: בְּרֹ֣ב שַׂרְעַפַּ֣י בְּקִרְבִּ֑י תַּ֝נְחוּמֶ֗יךָ יְֽשַׁעַשְׁע֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] multitude of my anxious thoughts within me, your consolations delight my soul.

en.L: In the multitude of my anxious thoughts within me, \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} consolations delight my soul.
en.B: When my worries crowd in on me, \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} comfort fills me with joy.
en.R: When I am very worried, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} comfort me and make me happy again.

fr.L: Dans la multitude de mes pensées inquiètes au-dedans de moi, \q {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consolations réjouissent mon âme.
fr.B: Quand les soucis m’assaillent, \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} réconfort me remplit de joie.
fr.R: Quand je suis très inquiet, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me réconfortes et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me rends la joie.

sw.L: Katika wingi wa mahangaiko yangu ndani yangu, \q faraja {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} huifurahisha nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Wasiwasi unaponisonga, \q faraja {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} hunijaza furaha.
sw.R: Ninapokuwa na wasiwasi mwingi, \q unanifariji na kunifanya nifurahi tena.

es.L: En la multitud de mis inquietudes dentro de mí, \q {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} consuelos deleitan mi alma.
es.B: Cuando me asaltan las preocupaciones, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} consuelo me llena de alegría.
es.R: Cuando estoy muy preocupado, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me consuelas y me vuelves a hacer feliz.

vi.L: Trong muôn vàn nỗi lo âu bên trong tôi, \q sự an ủi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm vui thích linh hồn tôi.
vi.B: Khi bao nỗi lo âu dồn dập trong tôi, \q sự an ủi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm tôi tràn đầy vui mừng.
vi.R: Khi tôi rất lo lắng, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} an ủi tôi và làm cho tôi vui trở lại.

decisions.choice: anxious thoughts: troubling, divided thoughts
decisions.reason: The word (sar'appim) is used of restless, worried thoughts (139:23).

decisions.choice: my soul: me
decisions.reason: As in verse 17: the whole person.

decisions.choice: me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "me" for "my soul" (m2).

source.text: הַֽ֭יְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי־חֹֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: Can [the] throne of destruction be allied with you, [one that] frames mischief by statute?

en.L: Can a throne of destruction be allied with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q one that frames mischief by statute?
en.B: Will a ruling power bent on ruin ever be {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} partner, \q one that uses the law to create misery?
en.R: Can evil rulers be friends with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? \q They make laws that hurt people!

fr.L: Le trône de la ruine serait-il {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} allié, \q lui qui façonne le malheur par décret ?
fr.B: Un pouvoir acharné à détruire sera-t-il jamais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} associé, \q lui qui se sert de la loi pour créer la misère ?
fr.R: Des chefs mauvais peuvent-ils être {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} amis ? \q Ils font des lois qui font du mal aux gens !

sw.L: Je, kiti cha enzi cha maangamizi kitashirikiana {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}, \q kile kibuniacho madhara kwa amri?
sw.B: Je, utawala unaolenga uharibifu utakuwa mshirika {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kamwe, \q ule unaotumia sheria kuleta mateso?
sw.R: Je, watawala waovu wanaweza kuwa rafiki {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}? \q Wanatunga sheria zinazowaumiza watu!

es.L: ¿Se aliará contigo un trono de destrucción, \q uno que fragua el mal por medio de la ley?
es.B: ¿Podrá un poder que solo busca la ruina ser alguna vez {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aliado, \q uno que usa la ley para causar miseria?
es.R: ¿Pueden ser {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} amigos los gobernantes malvados? \q ¡Hacen leyes que lastiman a la gente!

vi.L: Ngôi của sự hủy diệt có thể liên kết với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao, \q [ngôi] dùng luật lệ mà bày ra điều tai hại?
vi.B: Lẽ nào một quyền lực chỉ lo phá hoại lại được làm bạn với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q là quyền lực dùng luật pháp để gây khốn khổ?
vi.R: Những kẻ cai trị gian ác có thể làm bạn với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao? \q Chúng làm ra những luật lệ để hại người!

decisions.choice: a throne of destruction: corrupt rulers and courts
decisions.reason: A throne stands for those who rule and judge. Here they use their power and the law itself to harm the innocent (verse 21; Isaiah 10:1-2).

decisions.choice: frames: shapes, as a potter does
decisions.reason: The verb (yatsar) is the one used of God forming the eye (verse 9): God forms eyes to see, these rulers form misery.

decisions.choice: by statute: through the law
decisions.reason: The words ('ale-choq) most likely mean that they make harm into law; they could mean they plan trouble against what the law says.

source.text: יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְדָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: They band together against [the] life of [the] righteous, and innocent blood they condemn.

en.L: They band together against the life of the righteous, \q and innocent blood they condemn.
en.B: They gather against the righteous to take their lives, \q and they condemn innocent people to death.
en.R: They plot together to kill people who do what is right. \q They sentence innocent people to death.

fr.L: Ils se liguent contre la vie du juste, \q et le sang innocent, ils le condamnent.
fr.B: Ils se rassemblent contre le juste pour lui ôter la vie, \q et ils condamnent à mort des innocents.
fr.R: Ils complotent ensemble pour tuer ceux qui font ce qui est juste. \q Ils condamnent à mort des innocents.

sw.L: Wanakusanyika pamoja dhidi ya uhai wa mwenye haki, \q na damu isiyo na hatia wanaihukumu.
sw.B: Wanakusanyika dhidi ya wenye haki ili kuwaua, \q na wanawahukumu kifo watu wasio na hatia.
sw.R: Wanapanga pamoja kuwaua watu wanaotenda haki. \q Wanawahukumu kifo watu wasio na hatia.

es.L: Se juntan contra la vida del justo, \q y la sangre inocente condenan.
es.B: Se reúnen contra los justos para quitarles la vida, \q y condenan a muerte a los inocentes.
es.R: Se ponen de acuerdo para matar a la gente que hace lo que es justo. \q Condenan a muerte a gente inocente.

vi.L: Chúng họp lại chống nghịch mạng sống của người công chính, \q và kết án máu vô tội.
vi.B: Chúng tụ tập lại để lấy mạng người công chính, \q và chúng kết án tử hình người vô tội.
vi.R: Chúng cùng nhau bày mưu giết những người làm điều ngay thẳng. \q Chúng kết án tử hình những người vô tội.

decisions.choice: innocent blood: an innocent person's life
decisions.reason: To condemn innocent blood is to sentence an innocent person to death (Deuteronomy 19:10; 27:25).

decisions.choice: band together: gather as a troop
decisions.reason: The verb (gadad) is related to a word for a band of raiders; it may mean they gather against or that they attack.

source.text: וַיְהִ֬י יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י לְמִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝אלֹהַ֗י לְצ֣וּר מַחְסִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: But YHWH has become for me a high fortress, and my God [the] rock of my refuge.

en.L: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has become for me a high fortress, \q and my God the rock of my refuge.
en.B: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has proved to be my high fortress; \q my God has been a rock that shelters me.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} keeps me safe like a strong fortress. \q My God is like a rock where I can run for safety.

fr.L: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est devenu pour moi une haute forteresse, \q et mon Dieu le rocher de mon refuge.
fr.B: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est montré ma haute forteresse ; \q mon Dieu a été un rocher qui m’abrite.
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me garde en sécurité comme une forteresse solide. \q Mon Dieu est comme un rocher où je peux courir me mettre à l’abri.

sw.L: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekuwa kwangu ngome iliyo juu, \q na Mungu wangu mwamba wa kimbilio langu.
sw.B: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amethibitika kuwa ngome yangu iliyo juu; \q Mungu wangu amekuwa mwamba unaonihifadhi.
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hunilinda salama kama ngome imara. \q Mungu wangu ni kama mwamba ninaoweza kuukimbilia nipate usalama.

es.L: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha sido para mí una alta fortaleza, \q y mi Dios la roca de mi refugio.
es.B: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha resultado ser mi alta fortaleza; \q mi Dios ha sido una roca que me da refugio.
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me protege como una fortaleza fuerte. \q Mi Dios es como una roca donde puedo correr para estar a salvo.

vi.L: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã trở nên đồn lũy cao cho tôi, \q và Đức Chúa Trời tôi [là] vầng đá của nơi ẩn náu tôi.
vi.B: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã là đồn lũy trên cao của tôi; \q Đức Chúa Trời tôi là vầng đá che chở tôi.
vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giữ tôi an toàn như một đồn lũy vững chắc. \q Đức Chúa Trời tôi như vầng đá, nơi tôi có thể chạy đến để được an toàn.

decisions.choice: high fortress: a place out of reach
decisions.reason: The word (misgav) is a high, safe place (9:10; 18:3), from the verb of 91:14.

decisions.choice: refuge: shelter
decisions.reason: The word (machseh) is the one of 91:2 and 46:2.

source.text: וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם׀אֶת־אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he has brought back on them their iniquity, and in their evil he will destroy them; YHWH our God will destroy them.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has brought back on them their iniquity, \q and in their evil {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will destroy them; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God will destroy them.
en.B: He will make their evil recoil on them \q and put an end to them through their own wickedness; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God will put an end to them.
en.R: God will punish them for the evil they have done. \q He will destroy them because they are wicked. \q Yes, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God will wipe them out.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait retomber sur eux leur faute, \q et dans leur méchanceté {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les anéantira ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu les anéantira.
fr.B: Il fera retomber sur eux leur mal \q et les fera périr par leur propre méchanceté ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu les fera périr.
fr.R: Dieu les punira pour le mal qu’ils ont fait. \q Il les détruira parce qu’ils sont méchants. \q Oui, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu les fera disparaître.

sw.L: Naye amewarudishia uovu wao, \q na katika ubaya wao atawaangamiza; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu atawaangamiza.
sw.B: Atawarudishia uovu wao wenyewe \q na kuwakomesha kwa ubaya wao wenyewe; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu atawakomesha.
sw.R: Mungu atawaadhibu kwa ajili ya uovu walioutenda. \q Atawaangamiza kwa sababu ni waovu. \q Naam, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu atawafutilia mbali.

es.L: Y ha hecho volver sobre ellos su iniquidad, \q y en su maldad los destruirá; \q los destruirá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios.
es.B: Hará que su maldad caiga sobre ellos \q y acabará con ellos por su propia perversidad; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios acabará con ellos.
es.R: Dios los castigará por el mal que han hecho. \q Los destruirá porque son malvados. \q Sí, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios acabará con ellos.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem tội ác của chúng trở lại trên chúng, \q và trong sự gian ác của chúng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ hủy diệt chúng; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, sẽ hủy diệt chúng.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ làm cho điều ác của chúng quay lại trên chính chúng \q và tiêu diệt chúng bởi chính sự gian ác của chúng; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, sẽ tiêu diệt chúng.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời sẽ trừng phạt chúng vì điều ác chúng đã làm. \q Ngài sẽ hủy diệt chúng vì chúng gian ác. \q Phải, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, sẽ xóa sạch chúng.

decisions.choice: he has brought back: as good as done
decisions.reason: The first verb is in a past form; the next two are future. The psalmist speaks of God's judgment as already settled.

decisions.choice: bring back their iniquity on them: their evil comes back on them
decisions.reason: The wrong they did returns on their own heads (7:17).

decisions.choice: destroy: put an end to, silence
decisions.reason: The verb (tsamat) means to destroy completely, to silence (18:41; 54:7).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names who acts.
